issues.title: Inconsistent spacing around function arguments
issues.description: The code contains inconsistent spacing around commas in function arguments that violates the project's rustfmt configuration. Specifically, missing space after comma and extra spaces after comma in method calls.
issues.rule_name: Rust Code Must Be Formatted According to Project rustfmt Configuration

issues.title: Cookie deletion incorrectly calls SetCookie instead of DeleteCookie
issues.description: The delete_cookie function is sending a WebviewMessage::SetCookie message instead of WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie. This causes the cookie to be set/updated instead of being deleted when the delete_cookie API is called. Any code attempting to delete cookies will fail to remove them, and may inadvertently persist or update cookies that should be removed. This breaks the entire cookie deletion functionality and creates a security concern where sensitive cookies cannot be properly removed.

issues.title: Window size applied before position in window_features causing incorrect window placement
issues.description: In the window_features method, the size configuration is now applied before the position configuration, reversing the original order. This can lead to incorrect window positioning behavior because some window managers calculate the final window position based on the current window size. When the size is set after the position, the position may be recalculated or adjusted incorrectly. This particularly affects windows opened through the on_new_window handler when both size and position are specified in NewWindowFeatures.

issues.title: Changed window naming pattern breaks window label consistency
issues.description: The window label format for dynamically created windows has been changed from "new-{number}" to "new-window-{number}". This breaks the established naming convention and will cause any code that attempts to retrieve or manipulate these windows using the expected label format to fail. For example, code trying to access "new-0" or "new-1" will not find the windows, as they are now named "new-window-0" and "new-window-1". This affects window management, event handling, and any window lookup operations that depend on the label pattern.

issues.title: Public re-export lacks rustdoc documentation
issues.description: A new public API item (`pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;`) was added without a `///` documentation comment. Line comments (`// ...`) do not satisfy the rule requiring rustdoc comments for public APIs.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
// Remove this re-export in v3
pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;
issues.rule_name: Public APIs Must Include Documentation Comments

issues.title: New code uses unwrap() on fallible operations
issues.description: Added code introduces multiple `unwrap()` calls on fallible operations (`parse().unwrap()`, `set_title(...).unwrap()`, and `build().unwrap()`), which violates the rule prohibiting panics/unwraps in favor of explicit error handling via `Result`.
issues.rule_name: Functions Should Return Result Types for Fallible Operations

issues.title: User-facing API change without a .changes entry
issues.description: This PR changes a user-facing API (renaming/replacing `with_window_features` with `window_features` and updating docs/examples accordingly) but does not add any markdown change file under `.changes/` in the diff, violating the requirement to include a covector change file for releasable functionality/API changes.
issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14020 - fix: a few regressions from previous PRs
pr.author: unknown

structured_output.summary:
The PR is meant to clean up three regressions from earlier cookie and new-window work: it removes a redundant clone, re-exports `Cookie` from the `tauri::webview` module, and moves the API example's `on_new_window` handler behind the desktop-only cfg. It also renames the builder method `with_window_features` to `window_features`, which the description does not mention.

The cookie fix is wrong. In `tauri-runtime-wry`, the hunk changes `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie` to `SetCookie` inside `delete_cookie`, not `set_cookie`. In the base, `set_cookie` already sends `SetCookie`, so after this change both methods send `SetCookie` and `delete_cookie` silently sets the cookie instead of deleting it. That is a functional regression introduced by a PR meant to fix one.

The other parts are reasonable. The `Cookie` re-export resolves to the existing `tauri_runtime::Cookie`, and gating the example's `on_new_window` to `desktop, not(test)` matches the `window_features` cfg. However, the rename, a whitespace-broken `window_features` body, the swapped size/position order, and the unrelated window-label change are all outside the stated scope and should be split out or reverted.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The `delete_cookie` regression is a clear correctness bug: deleting a cookie now dispatches a set operation. It is a one-line fix, but it must land before merge. The rest (unannounced public rename, formatting that fails `cargo fmt`, unrelated label change) are fixable in the same pass.

architecture.overview:
Webview cookie and window-feature operations are exposed on `tauri::Webview` and `WebviewWindow` in `crates/tauri`. Those methods call the `WebviewDispatch` trait from `tauri-runtime`, and the Wry implementation in `crates/tauri-runtime-wry` turns each call into a `Message::Webview(window, webview, WebviewMessage::...)` sent over the user-event channel to the event loop. Each trait method maps to a distinct `WebviewMessage` variant, so a mismatch at the dispatch layer changes behavior with no compile-time signal.

This PR touches three spots. In the Wry dispatcher, `delete_cookie` should map to `DeleteCookie`, but the head sends `SetCookie`. The `tauri::webview` module now re-exports `tauri_runtime::Cookie` so callers can name the type without importing the cookie crate. The window-features builder method is renamed from `with_window_features` to `window_features`, and the API example's `on_new_window` callback is moved under a desktop-only cfg block.
steps: Entry point: user code calls `Webview::set_cookie` / `delete_cookie` (crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs) or the `WebviewWindow` equivalents, which forward to the runtime's `WebviewDispatch`.

In crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs, `set_cookie` (~line 1700) sends `WebviewMessage::SetCookie` and `delete_cookie` (~line 1712) should send `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie`. The PR changes the latter to `SetCookie`, which is the regression.
The `Cookie` type is now re-exported from `tauri::webview` via `pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie` (mod.rs line 23), replacing the local `use cookie::Cookie`. Cookie-typed signatures are unchanged.

`WebviewWindowBuilder::window_features` (webview_window.rs ~line 1315) replaces `with_window_features`. It applies `NewWindowFeatures` size and position to the window builder, then the platform-specific webview configuration. The size and position calls are reordered and reformatted.

The API example (examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs) installs `on_new_window` only inside `#[cfg(all(desktop, not(test)))]`, creating the popup window with `window_features(features)` and a new `new-window-{n}` label.

findings.title: delete_cookie now dispatches SetCookie instead of DeleteCookie
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs`, the `delete_cookie` method (around lines 1712-1722) now sends `WebviewMessage::SetCookie`, which turns deletions into sets. Change the message at about line 1718 back to `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie(cookie.into_owned())`. Keep the redundant-clone removal, since `cookie` is passed by value. `set_cookie` at about line 1706 already sends `SetCookie` and should not change. Consider adding a test that asserts the message variant each method dispatches.

findings.title: Unrelated public method rename with_window_features to window_features
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/webview/webview_window.rs`, the method at about line 1315 was renamed from `with_window_features` to `window_features`. The PR description does not mention this rename. Either revert it to `with_window_features` and update the doc example at about line 300, the call in `crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs` at about line 525, and the call in `examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` at about line 94. Or keep the rename and explain it in the PR description and in a `.changes` file. Follow the existing `with_webview_configuration` naming.

findings.title: Whitespace in window_features breaks rustfmt
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/webview/webview_window.rs` inside `window_features` (about lines 1315-1322), fix the spacing in the `inner_size(size.width, size.height)` and `position(position.x, position.y)` calls so there is one space after each comma. Run `cargo fmt` and confirm the file is clean.

findings.title: Unexplained reordering of size and position in window_features
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/webview/webview_window.rs` inside `window_features` (about lines 1315-1322), the PR swapped the order of the position and inner_size calls with no stated reason. Restore the original order, with position applied before inner_size, unless there is a documented reason for the swap. Keep the change focused on the rename and the regression fix.

findings.title: Example window label changed without explanation
findings.body:
The example's window label changed from `new-{number}` to `new-window-{number}`. This is not in the PR description and nothing in the repo depends on the old label (a grep found no references). It is a harmless but unexplained change. Revert it, or mention it in the PR if it is intentional.

findings.fixPrompt: In `examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` inside the `on_new_window` closure (about line 91), the window label was changed from `format!("new-{number}")` to `format!("new-window-{number}")`. This is not part of the PR's stated fixes. Revert the label to `new-{number}` unless the rename is intentional and documented.

findings.title: Cookie re-export moved cleanly to tauri::webview
findings.body:
Replacing the local `use cookie::Cookie;` with `pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;` removes a duplicate import and gives callers a `Cookie` type that matches the one used by `WebviewDispatch`. The `tauri_runtime` crate already re-exports `cookie::Cookie` at its root (`crates/tauri-runtime/src/lib.rs` line 46), so the re-export resolves. The 'Remove this re-export in v3' comment marks the intended deprecation path.

::diff{file="crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs" lines="19-24"}

findings.title: on_new_window gated to desktop in the API example
findings.body:
Moving the `on_new_window` registration under `#[cfg(all(desktop, not(test)))]` matches the cfg of `window_features`, which is only compiled on macOS, Windows, Linux and the BSDs. Mobile and test builds no longer reference an API that does not exist for them. The `created_window_count` and `app_` clone now live in the same gated block, so the example compiles cleanly on those targets.

::diff{file="examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs" lines="68-102"}
